entries.e5202a3f20bdc5c6: In April 2026, it formulated the medium-term management plan "One2030," with fiscal 2030 as its final year. In the Electronic Equipment-Related Business, in addition to making maximum use of the Fukuchiyama No. 2 Plant to expand the production volume of semiconductor-related products and improve productivity, it will start manufacturing semiconductor-related products at the Chuzhou Plant in China, and strengthen the development of the Chinese market through its sales bases in Shanghai and Beijing. In the Industrial Equipment-Related Business, while promoting the expansion of its global share of mechanical seals (rotary joints) for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, it will differentiate itself by developing and providing high-performance seal products for clean energy markets such as hydrogen, ammonia, and SAF, and will advance collaboration with Tanken Seal Seiko Co., Ltd. in the fields of technology, production, and sales. Note that the numerical targets of the plan are not transcribed.
